notes: Fiscal year 2024 ended November 3, 2024 (53 weeks; matches data.js fy 'Nov 2024'). Filings: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001730168-24-000139) and 2025 proxy statement (accession 0001193125-25-044112), both read on www.sec.gov. HOCK TAN: 1,844,746 shares including 1,131,910 held by a family trust; less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null. BUYBACKS are the repurchase-program line only; they exclude $5,216 million of 'Shares repurchased for tax withholdings on vesting of equity awards', a separate cash-flow line. STOCK COMP is the note total ($5,670 million), which excludes stock-based compensation of discontinued operations (VMware's end-user computing business, sold July 1, 2024); the cash-flow add-back including it is $5,741 million. It includes $1,613 million for awards assumed in the VMware merger. GEOGRAPHY: the regional table in Note 3 is used; the geographic-information section of the segment note gives country figures only for long-lived assets. Broadcom notes that title for most products transfers in Penang, Malaysia, so regions reflect shipment or delivery location, not end customers. HOLDERS: both 5% figures come from older 13G filings (Vanguard as of Sept 30, 2024; BlackRock as of Dec 31, 2023) divided by the February 2025 share count.

footprint.notes: The FY2024 10-K gives employees only as regional percentages (North America 48%, Asia 36%, EMEA 16% of ~37,000); headcounts were not derived. Item 2 splits facilities over 100,000 sq ft only into United States (3,769,028 sq ft) and Other Countries (3,283,661 sq ft), so no country rows. The 10-K also says a significant majority of R&D personnel are in the Czech Republic, India, Israel and the U.S., without numbers. Broadcom publishes EU public country-by-country tax reports (with employees by jurisdiction) on investors.broadcom.com, but that host returned 403 Access Denied to every fetch this session, so they are not used; worth a retry with a browser. No state-level data found. Sites are from the 10-K's own descriptions; the Singapore row cites the manufacturing sentence because its description is the company's generic wording.
